targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('day', occurred_at at time zone 'UTC'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, count(*)::int AS alerts FROM alerts WHERE occurred_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT coalesce(rule_id, 'unspecified') AS rule_id, count(*)::int AS alerts FROM alerts WHERE occurred_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT s.name, count(*)::int AS alerts FROM alerts a JOIN assets s ON s.id = a.asset_id WHERE a.occurred_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8
